items.t: Fast brake pad and rotor wear
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: Price is for the front axle. Rear brakes cost about the same again.

items.t: Ignition can switch off while driving (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine computer can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine wiring can rub through and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Repair and reroute engine wiring harness
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Door wiring breaks and disables side airbags (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Airbag control unit can corrode (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Power steering pressure hose can leak and catch fire (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Power steering hose can burst in cold weather (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall for some years. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Left cylinder head misfire (3.6L warranty extension)
items.note: Chrysler's 10-year/150,000-mile extension has likely expired. Still ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Oil filter housing and cooler leak (3.6L)
items.job: Replace oil filter housing and oil cooler assembly
items.note: Use the updated aluminum-style housing. Coolant may need to be refilled too.

items.t: Connecting rod bearing failure (3.6L recall)
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured 3.6L
items.note: Covered by recall for affected engines. Check your VIN or ask the dealer before paying.

items.t: Contaminated brake fluid (recall)
items.job: Flush brake fluid and replace affected parts
items.note: Covered by recall. Low end is a fluid flush; high end includes new brake parts.

items.t: ABS and stability control quit in wet weather (recall)
items.job: Seal ABS module connector and repair wiring
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: 2.4L engine cover can fall onto exhaust (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Driver airbag wiring can chafe (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace clock spring wiring
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: False low oil pressure code (3.6L)
items.note: Check the actual oil pressure first so a real engine problem is ruled out.

items.t: Cruise control may not disengage (recall)
items.note: Software update done free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Sudden loss of drive power (transmission pump recall)
items.job: Replace transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: The recall adds a software update, and failed units are usually replaced under it. Check your VIN.

items.t: Crank or cam sensor can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace crankshaft or camshaft position sensor
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear brake caliper pistons may reduce braking (recall)
items.note: Price is for both rear calipers. Covered by recall; check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine computer power chip can fail (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera image missing or distorted (recalls)
items.job: Update radio software or replace backup camera
items.note: Covered by recalls. Low end is a software update; high end is a new camera.
